description.zh: 审计日志的请求来源，取值为**Console**。
description.en: The source of the request. Set this parameter to **Console**.

description.zh:
审计日志状态，取值：
- **enable**：开启审计日志。
- **disabled**：关闭审计日志。
description.en:
The status of the audit log. Valid values:

- **enable**: Enables the audit log feature.

- **disabled**: Disables the audit log feature.

description.zh: 在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本中生效，为审计日志热存储天数，取值范围为0-7，单位天。
description.en: This parameter is effective only for the **V2\_Standard** (DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL Compatible) audit log) edition. It specifies the hot storage duration for the audit log. Valid values: 0 to 7. Unit: days.

description.zh:
审计日志的版本类型。

- **Trial**：免费试用版。
- **Standard**：正式版。
- **V2_Standard** ：DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志。
> - 该参数的默认值为**Trial**。从2022年01月06日起，各地域将陆续上线正式版审计日志，并终止申请免费试用版审计日志。
> - 从2026年2月起，各地域将陆续上线DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志，并终止申请正式版审计日志。
description.en:
The edition of the audit log. Valid values:

- **Trial**: Trial Edition.

- **Standard**: Standard Edition.

- **V2\_Standard**: DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL Compatible) audit log.

> * The default value of this parameter is **Trial**. Starting from January 6, 2022, the Standard edition is being rolled out across regions, and new applications for the Trial edition are no longer accepted.
>
> * Starting from February 2026, the DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL Compatible) audit log will be rolled out across regions, and new applications for the Standard edition will no longer be accepted.

description.zh:
- 在Standard（正式版）版本中，为审计日志保留时长。取值范围为1~365天，默认为30天。

- 在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本中，为审计日志冷存储天数，取值范围为30、180、365、1095、1825，单位天。
description.en:
- For the **Standard** edition, this parameter specifies the retention period for the audit log. Valid values: 1 to 365. The default value is 30. Unit: days.

- For the **V2\_Standard** (DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL Compatible) audit log) edition, this parameter specifies the cold storage duration for the audit log. Valid values: 30, 180, 365, 1095, and 1825. Unit: days.

title.zh: 设置实例的审计日志开关或日志存储时长

descriptions.zh: - 本接口限制每分钟调用30次，如超过这个限制会被限流，请勿高频调用。如需高频调用，请使用Logstore，详情请参见[管理Logstore](~~48990~~)。
descriptions.en: - You can call this operation up to 30 times per minute. The system throttles calls that exceed this limit. Avoid calling this operation frequently. If you need to make frequent calls, use Logstore. For more information, see [Manage Logstore](~~48990~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-audit-policy --db-instance-id dds-bp1785659e3f0000 --audit-status enable --storage-period 30 --audit-log-switch-source Console --service-type Standard --hot-storage-period 7 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds ModifyAuditPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --StoragePeriod 30 --AuditStatus enable --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp1785659e3f0000' --ServiceType Standard --HotStoragePeriod 7 --AuditLogSwitchSource Console
